name: markor_create_note_and_send_sms
intent: Create a note in Markor and share its content via SMS
description: Create a new text note in Markor with a specified name and content, save it, then send the note's entire content by SMS to a specified phone number using Simple SMS Messenger.
patterns: Create a note and text its contents to a phone number
Make a new note in Markor and SMS it to someone
Create a text file and share it by SMS
Write a note and send it as a text message

inputs.name: note_name
inputs.description: The base file name for the new note, without its extension.

inputs.name: file_extension
inputs.description: The file extension for the new note.

inputs.name: note_text
inputs.description: The entire text content to place in the note and send by SMS.

inputs.name: recipient_phone_number
inputs.description: The phone number that should receive the SMS.

steps.intent: Launch Markor to create a new note
Tap the button to create a new file or folder
steps.target_fixed_text: Create a new file or folder

steps.intent: Type {{note_name}} as the new file name
Tap OK to create the file
Tap Save to save the note
Go back to the file list after saving the note
Launch Simple SMS Messenger to share the note content
Tap the option to start a new conversation
Confirm the recipient to open the conversation
Type {{note_text}} into the SMS message field
Tap SMS to send the message
